text:
Maya: Heads-up — Acme just announced per-tenant routing with per-tenant SLOs. This shifts the competitive bar on routing. Can we triage impact on roadmap? Quick sync 3pm?
Sam: On it. Do we need to match parity or lean into something better?
Liam: From infra perf tests, per-tenant keys blow up continuous-batching efficiency — expect ~15-20% latency regression if we naively shard.
Erica: Design note: parity requires a small set of UX controls (tenant SLO toggles, simple rollout modal). Roughly 3 sprints to polish.
Aaron: Sales: one late-stage prospect made this a gating requirement. If we can show a canary we likely close $250k ARR this quarter.
Maya: Proposed options: A) Quick parity shim (feature flag + canary in Dedicated) — ~4w. B) Long-term differentiator: smart-routing policy + telemetry + Optimize integration — 10-12w. Need clear acceptance criteria for both.
Sam: If we do A, acceptance should be minimal but measurable. What does the checklist look like?
Liam: Draft acceptance (quick):
```
- Functionally route by tenant id with policy fallback
- Canary on Dedicated pool for 5k reqs/day for 7 days
- 95th latency increase <= 25% vs baseline or absolute < 300ms
- Observable per-tenant token cost delta and KV cache hit rate
- Feature-flagged and auto-rollback on error rate spike
```
Sam: That looks reasonable. We should also require an ops runbook and capacity bump approval.
vince-bot: perf-bench-results: https://redwood.internal/bench/314159 — baseline vs route-by-tenant variant attached. (automated)
Liam: Bench link shows batching buckets shrink ~30% for high-cardinality tenants; predicted +12% token cost.
Erica: UX minimal path: surface toggle + simple SLO slider. Advanced controls (policy editor) can be in roadmap phase 2.
Aaron: Sales needs a one-pager with launch criteria and risks we can share with the prospect by EOD Friday.
Maya: Decision proposal: hybrid approach — ship parity shim (A) to unblock sales with strict canary controls + feature flag. Parallelly kickoff differentiator epic (B) with product/infra milestones. Owner: Sam.
Sam: I'll own PRD + rollout runbook. Target: PRD by EOD tomorrow, canary in Dedicated in 4 weeks. Pinging infra for capacity and infra-sre for canary window.
Liam: I'll add perf mitigations: automatic KV prefix caching and batching policy adjustments to reduce cost impact.
Erica: I'll draft the minimal UX for the shim and a phase 2 spec.
Aaron: I'll prep the sales one-pager and list the risk talking points.
Maya: Great. Action items: Sam (PRD + owner), Liam (perf mitigations spike), Erica (UX mock + phase 2), Aaron (sales one-pager). We'll reconvene 3pm. :thumbsup:
Sam: Noted — creating JIRA epic and tagging @eng-platform and @eng-sre.
Erica: Quick note — surface telemetry in Console: per-tenant latency + cost. Otherwise sales will call it out.
Maya: Agreed. Add console metrics to the canary acceptance.
Sam: Will do. Closing loop after the 3pm sync.
